subtitle: Lesson 7 · Azure to AWS, Every Night

code:
az sql db export \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-prod \
  --server driftwood-sql-prod \
  --name storefrontdb \
  --storage-uri "https://driftwoodstorageprod.blob.core.windows.net/db-backups/storefrontdb-$(date +%F).bacpac"
caption: A nightly .bacpac export lands the storefront database in Blob Storage.

code:
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 7 * * *"

steps:
  - uses: azure/login@v2        # OIDC, Azure side
  - run: az storage blob download ...
  - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4   # OIDC, AWS side
    with:
      role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/driftwood-replication-role
  - run: aws s3 cp ./latest-backup.bacpac s3://driftwood-app-backups/...
caption: Two OIDC trust relationships, zero stored long-lived secrets.

steps.label: aws s3 ls
steps.sub: Confirms a new dated prefix landed after the scheduled run
